Before you buy

Good to know

  • Made for any adult or mixed group. No alcohol-required games.
  • Everything is optional. Any game or prompt can be skipped.
  • Favorite Things Match keeps it light: guests share only what they are comfortable saying aloud.
  • Kind Words & Valentine Notes is opt-in, and notes are shared privately.
  • Photo games are consent-first: ask before photographing anyone, and no posting without permission.
  • Not tied to a year, so you can use it every February.
  • Print guest sheets per player or team, and host sheets and keys once.
  • Printed colors vary between screens, printers, inks and paper.
  • Personal-use license. Resale and redistribution are not permitted.

Quick answers

Do I need to play all 15 games?

No. Choose the games that fit your group and schedule; the Host Guide suggests 1-, 2- and 3-hour plans.

Which file should I print?

Open the folder for your paper size (US Letter or A4), then choose Color or Low-Ink. Test-print one page first.

Where can I get printing help?

See the printing tips and FAQ pages on our store.
